page_title: BAR 3-0 LEV | Barcelona v Levante 22/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' The percentage of ball possession is – 73:27.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' Fermín (Barcelona) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the middle of the goal, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Mathew Ryan. What a save!
88' Substitution. Nacho Perez (Levante) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jeremy Toljan walks off.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) will replace Lamine Yamal.
88' Hansi Flick has decided to substitute Gerard Martin and he is replaced by Ronald Araujo (Barcelona).
86' Mathew Ryan displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Raphinha (Barcelona) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
84' Raphinha (Barcelona) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
84' The referee allows time for a substitution. Carlos Alvarez will be replaced by Iker Losada (Levante).
83' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
81' 3 - 0 Fermín (Barcelona) picks up the ball and releases a rocket of a shot towards the net. It bounces in off the right post and past the goalkeeper. Take a bow, a tremendous strike.
81' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
81' The ball is cleared after Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
80' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
80' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Lamine Yamal (Barcelona). The ball is out of play. Barcelona win a corner kick.
78' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Levante comes to nothing.
76' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) leaps highest to meet the resulting corner and attempts to head home, but the effort goes harmlessly wide of the left post.
76' Corner kick. Fermín (Barcelona) is ready to send the ball into the box.

76' Fermín (Barcelona) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Barcelona.
76' Raphinha (Barcelona) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
75' Raphinha (Barcelona) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Barcelona get a corner.
74' The linesman raises his flag. Tai Abed (Levante) is adjudged offside.
72' The attendance is 44936.
70' Levante fail to score from a corner as Joan Garcia (Barcelona) leaps to collect the ball.
70' Luis Castro has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Karl Etta Eyong (Levante) replacing Ivan Romero.
70' Substitution. Tai Abed (Levante) has come on for Kareem Tunde.
66' The referee signals a substitution. Fermín (Barcelona) is brought on as a substitute for Dani Olmo.
66' Here is a change. Marc Bernal is going off and Hansi Flick gives the last tactical orders to Pedri (Barcelona).
66' Substitution. Robert Lewandowski did his best and is replaced by Ferran Torres (Barcelona).
65' Barcelona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
65' Wow, what an escape. Raphinha (Barcelona) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
63' Levante take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
63' Paco Cortes (Levante) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Levante.
63' The corner is swung in but Levante can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
59' Today's referee Javier Alberola rightly decides to book Marc Bernal (Barcelona) for his harsh tackle.
58' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Mathew Ryan is alert and denies him.
56' Raphinha (Barcelona) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
55' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Barcelona will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
54' The shot by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Mathew Ryan.
52' Raphinha (Barcelona) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
52' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player.
51' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

51' Raphinha (Barcelona) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
50' Barcelona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
50' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) serves up a nice cross, but Mathew Ryan punches the ball away. Barcelona earn a corner.
47' Levante have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
46' Marc Bernal (Barcelona) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' That will be all from Victor Garcia who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Paco Cortes (Levante).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Javier Alberola has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Javier Alberola shows a yellow card to Gerard Martin (Barcelona) for a tough tackle.
45+2' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Ivan Romero (Levante) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
43' The game is interrupted now, Ivan Romero (Levante) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
40' A great solo run by Carlos Alvarez (Levante) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort low towards the middle of the goal was easily caught by Joan Garcia.
37' It looked like the long-range shot by Kareem Tunde (Levante) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the right post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
35' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
32' 2 - 0 Spectacular goal! Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) brilliantly darts into the box to latch on to a cross and buries the ball into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper stunned!
31' The Barcelona players are exchanging some short passes.
28' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
28' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and Barcelona manage to earn a corner.
27' Raphinha (Barcelona) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
27' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header only flies onto the right post and away off it!
26' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
23' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
22' A pass by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
20' Raphinha (Barcelona) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
20' A yellow card for a tackle by Kareem Tunde (Levante). Javier Alberola doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
18' Barcelona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
18' The game is interrupted as Carlos Alvarez (Levante) is flagged offside.
17' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Javier Alberola blows his whistle for a foul.

15' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Joan Garcia anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
14' Manu Sanchez (Levante) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
13' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
12' Levante quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
10' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) commits a foul and Javier Alberola immediately signals a free kick.
8' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) misses a rebound from close range. His effort floats narrowly over the crossbar!
6' Great teamplay by Barcelona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
6' Flag up against Kareem Tunde (Levante). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
4' 1 - 0 Goal! Marc Bernal (Barcelona) takes a short pass from Eric Garcia in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
4' Raphinha (Barcelona) works the corner short.
3' A cross into the box picks out Jules Kounde (Barcelona), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot high over the bar.
2' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
1' The first half has started.
Levante will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Javier Alberola.
